overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies turmeric powder for B2B buyers who need a practical ingredient for seasoning, colour, and formulation work. The product is processed from selected Indian turmeric rhizomes through cleaning, controlled drying, grinding, sieving, inspection, and packing. Standard supply supports 80 mesh material, with other mesh sizes available on request.

We serve manufacturers, distributors, traders, and private label buyers with bulk supply, OEM packing, and custom specifications. Orders can be handled with flexible packaging formats, including bulk packs and small retail-ready packs on request. Samples are available for qualified inquiries, and export documentation support can be discussed at the quotation stage.

faqs.q: What is the standard mesh size for turmeric powder?
faqs.a: The standard grade is 80 mesh. Other mesh sizes can be discussed on request based on your application.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.a: The MOQ starts from 5 Kg, subject to the packaging format and order details.

faqs.q: Do you offer OEM and private label supply?
faqs.a: Yes. We support OEM and private label packing for bulk and retail-oriented requirements.
Standard packaging includes 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5–10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches or jars.
